court.serves_note: Serves northern San Diego County including San Marcos; handles Civil, Criminal, Family Law, Appeals, Adoption, and Traffic cases
court.snippet: The North County Superior Court is a full service branch court. Currently the Court hears Criminal, Civil, Family Law, Appeals, Adoption, Traffic and Minor Offense cases. This branch court has a venue encompassing most of Northern San Diego County.
